description: Playwright live testing: start dev server, capture screenshots at desktop/tablet/mobile, inspect console, network, accessibility snapshot, and test CTA links. Record all observations.
steps: Start dev server: npm run dev (background) in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/
Wait for server to be ready on http://localhost:3000
Take full-page desktop screenshot (1280x800) - save as desktop.png
Resize to tablet (768x1024), take screenshot - save as tablet.png
Resize to mobile (375x812), take screenshot - save as mobile.png
Test 'Deploy Now' CTA link - verify it opens in new tab or navigates
Test 'Documentation' CTA link - verify it opens in new tab or navigates
Test keyboard navigation: Tab through all focusable elements
Evaluate JavaScript for any uncaught errors
Evaluate DOM for missing alt text, aria labels, heading hierarchy
Record all findings for inclusion in QA_REPORT.md
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots taken at desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
verification: All observations recorded for report writing
findings: Playwright testing completed successfully using playwright-core directly within the bwrap sandbox (Playwright MCP cannot reach localhost from its network namespace due to bwrap isolation). Dev server started via Node.js subprocess. Screenshots captured at 4 viewports. Key findings: (1) HTTP 200, FCP 96ms, DOMContentLoaded 76ms. (2) 1 browser console warning: Vercel logo aspect ratio. (3) 0 network errors. (4) Keyboard navigation works correctly for all 4 links. (5) Focus ring present but thin (1px auto). (6) Body font is Arial not Geist (CSS override bug confirmed). (7) No CSP headers. (8) Missing OG meta tags. (9) Non-semantic outer div confirmed. (10) 'Deploy Now' and 'Documentation' links have target=_blank with rel=noopener noreferrer. Screenshots in qa-screenshots/ and .kiro/artifacts/screenshots/. Raw data in qa-results.json.
